description: Get Google search results, including the AI Overview and People also ask.

as_dt.description:
Includes or excludes as_sitesearch.

Requires as_sitesearch.
as_dt.title: As Dt

as_lq.description: Require results that link to this URL.
as_lq.title: As Lq

as_nhi.description:
Inclusive range upper bound.

Requires as_nlo.
as_nhi.title: As Nhi

as_nlo.description:
Inclusive range lower bound.

Requires as_nhi.
as_nlo.title: As Nlo

as_qdr.description: Quick range d, w, m, or y with an optional positive count.
as_qdr.title: As Qdr

as_rq.description: Find pages related to this URL.
as_rq.title: As Rq

as_sitesearch.description: Site hostname to include or exclude.
as_sitesearch.title: As Sitesearch

cr.description: One or more countryXX restrictions joined with |.
cr.title: Cr

device.description: Request device profile and radius bound.
device.title: Device

fast_mode.description:
Return organic results only, skipping AI Overview and all other result groups.

Keeps search metadata and parameters. Omits cross-module position_absolute.
fast_mode.title: Fast Mode

google_domain.description: Results use google.com. Use gl, hl, cr, lr or geography for localization.
google_domain.title: Google Domain

gs_lp.description: Google gs_lp value associated with an autocomplete selection.
gs_lp.title: Gs Lp

hl.description: Google interface and result language code.
hl.title: Hl

kgmid.description: Google Knowledge Graph machine ID, such as /m/0k8z.
kgmid.title: Kgmid

lat.description:
Latitude from -90 through 90.

Requires lon and conflicts with location and uule.
lat.title: Lat

location.description:
Human-readable city-level location encoded to UULE by Litescrape.

Conflicts with uule and lat/lon.
location.title: Location

lon.description:
Longitude from -180 through 180.

Requires lat and conflicts with location and uule.
lon.title: Lon

lr.description: One or more lang_xx restrictions joined with |.
lr.title: Lr

lsig.description: Opaque Knowledge Graph or local-pack signature.
lsig.title: Lsig

ludocid.description: Google local CID used to search for one entity.
ludocid.title: Ludocid

oq.description: Original query associated with an autocomplete selection.
oq.title: Oq

page_token.description:
Opaque token from pagination.next_page_token. Send it alone to fetch the next page with the original search parameters.

Prefer page_token to repeating the same search with start=10, start=20, or another offset. Send the token as soon as possible and no later than 5 minutes after receiving it. Available for ordinary Google Search, including fast mode; not available for tbm verticals. search_metadata.continuation is followed for a direct request. If Google omits a required link or the deadline expires, the request fails without billing.
page_token.title: Page Token

peek_pws.description: Google personalization peek flag, forwarded unchanged.
peek_pws.title: Peek Pws

pws.description: Google personalization control; 0 asks for non-personalized results.
pws.title: Pws

q.description:
Google Search query, up to 2,048 characters.

Required unless ludocid, kgmid, or page_token is supplied.
q.title: Q

radius.description:
Decimal search-bias radius in meters.

Requires location or lat/lon. Desktop: 1–199; tablet/mobile: 1–1,000.
radius.title: Radius

result_groups.description: Return only these top-level result groups, e.g. ["organic_results", "knowledge_graph"]; omit for the complete response. search_metadata is always kept

sclient.description: Google client identifier such as gws-wiz-serp.
sclient.title: Sclient

start.description:
Non-negative Google result offset.

Prefer page_token to repeating the same search with start=10, start=20, or another offset.
start.title: Start

tbm.description: Google vertical: lcl, vid, nws, shop, or pts. For image searches, use /api/google/images.
tbm.title: Tbm

tbs.description: Google native date or search filter string.
tbs.title: Tbs

uule.description:
Pre-encoded Google location value.

Conflicts with location and lat/lon.
uule.title: Uule

name: google_search
title: Google Search
